failed_attempts_before_success: numpy 2.1.2 then 2.0.2: torch 2.4 Windows build fails its NumPy bridge ('Failed to initialize NumPy: _ARRAY_API not found', torch.from_numpy raises 'Numpy is not available'). Fixed with numpy==1.26.4 + scipy==1.13.1 + scikit-learn==1.5.2 + numba==0.60.0 era pins.
Run 1: UnicodeEncodeError - demo Timer prints Chinese phase names to a cp1252 stdout. Fixed with PYTHONUTF8=1 / PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 env.
Run 2: CUDA OOM at prompt_bs=32 (one torch.cat tried to allocate 9.26 GiB; peak 11,781 MiB).
Run 3: --prompt_bs 4 on the CLI changed nothing - upstream __main__ never forwards --prompt_bs to predict_aabb (default 32 always used). Fixed by patching the LAB COPY default to 4.

method: Both proof meshes decimated to 50,000 faces (Blender Decimate COLLAPSE) because P3-SAM's post-processing builds full face-adjacency structures. P3-SAM itself samples a fixed 100,000 surface points and 400 FPS prompts (hardcoded), predicts per-point masks, then votes them onto faces of the input mesh. seed=42, --parallel 0, post_process=0 (CLI default).

outputs.key_files: auto_mask_mesh_final.glb / .ply (colorized, per-face colors), auto_mask_mesh_final_face_ids.npy (int64 per-face ids aligned to the INPUT mesh's face order), auto_mask_mesh_final_aabb.npy

runs.input: snow-goblin-50k.glb - 49,999 faces after upstream clean_mesh (source textured.glb: 854,106 v / 1,072,406 f)

phase_seconds_from_own_timers.note: remaining ~40s = imports + Sonata/P3-SAM weight load (not separately timer'd)

runs.verdict_reason: Both arms carry labels different from the chest/ruff label, and the boundary sits at the shoulder/armpit in front, side and back renders - the fused-fur arm<->torso test PASSES. Caveats: head is fused into the torso label (74.9%); one ear is its own label; light single-face speckle inside large labels; lower body is over-split into 5 small labels (shorts/legs/feet pieces, each anatomical).

phase_seconds_from_own_timers.note: rest of phases same structure as goblin, shorter postprocess

runs.verdict_reason: Head+frill split cleanly at the neck, and the two FAR-side legs get their own labels with boundaries at plausible shoulder/hip lines - but both NEAR-side legs remain fused into the body/belly label (68.3% of faces). Only 2 of 4 legs separate from the belly, so the leg<->belly test half-passes: parts exist and two boundaries are anatomical, but the split is inconsistent across symmetric legs.

shims: LAB COPY ONLY - XPart/partgen/models/sonata/model.py: activated the authors' own commented-out line ckpt['config']['enable_flash']=False (no flash-attn Windows wheel exists; SDPA fallback path used).
LAB COPY ONLY - P3-SAM/demo/auto_mask.py: predict_aabb default prompt_bs 32 -> 4 (upstream __main__ parses --prompt_bs but never forwards it; 32 OOMs on 12 GB).
Era pins: numpy==1.26.4, scipy==1.13.1, scikit-learn==1.5.2, numba==0.60.0 (torch 2.4.0+cu121 Windows NumPy-bridge incompatibility with numpy>=2.0.2).
Env: PYTHONUTF8=1, PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 (Chinese Timer prints vs cp1252), PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True.
Sonata weights pre-seeded to D:\root\sonata\sonata.pth because model.py hardcodes download_root='/root/sonata' (drive-relative on Windows; resolves to the cwd drive, D: in the lab).
Weights passed via explicit --ckpt_path (the built-in HF download path joins expanduser('~') with an absolute-looking subpath, which mis-resolves on Windows).
unload_behaviour: One process per mesh (load -> run -> exit). VRAM returned to baseline after every run (783 vs 774 baseline; 789 vs 795). VERIFIED by stage_runner sampling.
